Zoos are places where people go to see animals, not to get fed by the staff. Also, from a moral standpoint, expecting someone else to feed your children might be seen as neglecting your own responsibility as a parent. In conclusion, while cultural expectations might vary, the general consensus is that zookeepers are responsible for the animals, not the visitors.
